data.body:
Patchset 5 (Gerrit 2226) answers all three findings with one design change rather than three patches.

BLOCKING (api-compat): 'public/MCP reads now RAISE for a previously-valid case'. The finding
is correct — this IS a breaking change to a public surface, and it is the point of the ticket.
What was missing is what makes a breaking change *usable*: a way for a consumer to tell THIS
fault apart from every other read failure. Added:
  - a new stable code `store_uninitialized` in rebar.KNOWN_ERROR_CODES, set via the existing
    exc.error_code seam (_errors.error_code_for precedence 5), so it surfaces over the MCP
    error envelope rather than collapsing into `command_failed`;
  - a CHANGELOG [Unreleased]/Changed entry with an explicit migration line: a caller that
    relied on the empty-list degrade catches RebarError and branches on
    error_code_for(exc) == 'store_uninitialized'; an INITIALIZED-but-empty store still returns
    [] unchanged, so only the missing-store case is affected.
This is the same principle docs/mcp-reference.md:7 already states for config faults — surface a
distinct code 'instead of silently resolving to a fallback', so a driving agent can tell a
broken environment from a legitimate result. Verified end-to-end: the code is emitted, is in
KNOWN_ERROR_CODES, and is distinct from command_failed.

ADVISORY (maintainability): the audit guard matched the substring 'not initialized', coupling
audit.server to wording defined in four other modules. Fixed by the same change — it now
matches error_code_for(exc) == 'store_uninitialized'. The reviewer was right that the string
was the wrong seam; it was a stopgap and is gone.

ADVISORY (tests): the re-raise branch was untested. Added
test_audit_index_still_propagates_a_non_store_read_failure — a RebarError carrying
command_failed must propagate, not degrade. Without it a future 'simplification' to a bare
`except RebarError: return []` would reintroduce the exact silent-empty failure this ticket
removes, just relocated into the audit server. That is the more valuable half of the guard.

113 affected tests green; make lint and make typecheck clean.
